title: Design System: Group LN — Public Site

display.purpose: Home hero headline and the largest page-hero titles. Playfair Display 500, ~39px, scaling to ~30px on phones.

headline.purpose: Section headlines on content pages and the footer quote. Playfair Display 500, ~34px.

title.purpose: Sub-section headers and card/list-item titles. Playfair Display 600, ~19px.

body.purpose: Paragraph text and form values. Avenir 400, 16px, line-height 1.7.

label.purpose: Section kickers, footer column titles, button text, nav links. Avenir 700 UPPERCASE, 10-13px, letter-spacing 1-2.6px.

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the white hero CTA sitting on photo/video so it reads as foremost and pressable. Deepens to 0 14px 34px on hover with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Content cards are near-flat at rest and rise to this (up to 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)) on hover, paired with a small translateY.

shadows.name: card-rest-soft
shadows.purpose: Optional faint resting shadow on some standalone content cards (e.g. About).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Structural depth for elements that truly float: hero search dropdowns, the navigation overlay panel, modals.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and the scroll-cue hint loop.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal entrance for .reveal blocks (from opacity:0 translateY(24px)); staggered 100ms per sibling, capped at 4, gated behind html.js-reveal and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button (solid green)
components.description: The main action on content pages, e.g. "Neem contact op".
components.html: Neem contact op
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-primary, #00532D); color: #fff; font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #006638); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Light Button (primary CTA over media)
components.description: The hero's primary call-to-action, white on the video, lifting on a soft shadow.
components.html: Bekijk ons aanbod te koop
components.css: .ds-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 30px; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); transition: background 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.32); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary link on content pages, e.g. "Meer over Group LN". Inverts to a green fill on hover.
components.html: Meer over Group LN
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 22px; border: 1.5px solid var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-primary, #00532D); border-color: var(--color-primary, #00532D); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (secondary over media)
components.description: The hero's quieter secondary action beside the white CTA — opens the search bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="13" height="13" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M11 11l4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg> Zoek in het aanbod</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.55); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #fff; font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost[aria-expanded="true"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Round Menu Button
components.description: The navigation menu toggle — a round brass icon button, present at every width; the only nav affordance below 992px.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Menu openen"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 16" width="20" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 1.25h20M0 8h20M0 14.75h20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 46px; height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); color: var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--color-cta-hover, #B8935A); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cta, #C9A96E); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact / application form field. Border-shift + faint green wash on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.8px; color: var(--tekst-sub, #5A6B58); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(0,83,45,0.10)); border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: var(--groen-diep, #2C3B2A); font-family: 'Avenir', 'Open Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--tekst-sub, #5A6B58); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #00532D); background: rgba(0,83,45,0.03); } .ds-input.ds-invalid { border-color: #C0392B; }

narrative.overview:
The Group LN public site is built from two materials. A deep pine green does almost all the structural work — header, footer, primary buttons, links, and the small tracked labels that head every section. Against it sits exactly one accent: a warm brass-gold, used sparingly for the things that must be noticed first — a call-to-action over a photograph, the round menu button, a focus ring, a hover state on an otherwise quiet outline. Everything else is warm neutral: pages rest on a green-tinted off-white, never pure white and never cool grey, and text is a near-black green rather than true black. The result should feel like worked timber and aged metal — grounded, warm, and unhurried.

The type carries the warmth. Playfair Display sets every heading — high-contrast, slightly old-world, confident at large sizes — while Avenir handles body copy and the uppercase labels with a clean, humanist calm. Headings are large and set in medium weight (500); the drama comes from scale and the serif's own contrast, not from weight. Body text runs generous and airy (16px, line-height 1.7).

Components lean warm and tactile. Buttons carry real vertical padding, primary actions over imagery lift on a genuine soft shadow, cards raise slightly on hover, and the recurring round brass icon button reads as a physical control. Depth is used, not avoided — but it is quiet: hairline green borders separate most surfaces, and a heavy shadow is reserved for things that genuinely float. The site is implemented on a heavily-overridden Okler/Porto admin theme; that theme is the substrate, not the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Two-material identity: deep pine green structure + one warm-gold accent, nothing else saturated.
Warm neutrals only — green-tinted off-white page (#F2F5EF), near-black-green text, hairline green borders. No cool blue-grey.
Playfair Display headings at medium weight; Avenir body and uppercase tracked labels.
A small uppercase kicker heads most sections — an established, deliberate convention here.
Near-flat surfaces with a tactile touch: soft lift on primary CTAs and hovered cards; structural shadow only for floating layers.
Base corner radius 3px; bespoke marketing components soften to 4–8px; icon buttons and avatars are fully round.
Solid pine-green header (transparent over the home hero) and a solid pine-green footer.

rules.name: The Two-Material Rule
rules.body: Deep Green and Warm Gold are the only saturated colours on any screen. Green is structure and default action; gold is the one thing to look at first. A third saturated colour is either a validation error (Brick Red) or a mistake.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans warm and green. Reach for Warm Off-White and the green Hairline before any cool #f1f5f9-family grey. The page is never pure white.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: If gold appears more than about once per viewport of content, it has stopped meaning "look here". Kickers on light backgrounds are green, not gold; gold kickers are only for dark/photographic backgrounds.

rules.name: The Medium-Weight Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are Playfair at 500. Do not reach for 700/800 or a second family for emphasis — go up in size, or let the serif's own contrast carry it.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Small tracked uppercase text is always Avenir 700. It is the only place tracking is used; body and headings are set at normal spacing.

rules.name: The Warm-Canvas Rule
rules.body: Page background is always Warm Off-White (#F2F5EF). Cards and panels are white on top of it; the tonal step plus a hairline border is what separates them.

rules.name: The Float-Earns-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A heavy (Overlay-strength) shadow means the element literally floats above the page — a menu, a dropdown, a dialog. Resting content gets a hairline border and, at most, the soft Card-hover lift on interaction.

rules.name: The 3-to-8 Rule
rules.body: Corners run 3px (theme base) → 4–6px (bespoke marketing buttons and sections) → 8px (floating panels). Nothing in between drifts to a random one-off value, and nothing that isn't a round icon button or avatar becomes a pill.

dos: Do keep Deep Green (#00532D) as the structural colour and Warm Gold (#C9A96E) as the single accent — about one gold mark per viewport.
Do put every page on the Warm Off-White canvas (#F2F5EF); white is for cards and panels on top of it.
Do set headings in Playfair Display at weight 500 and build hierarchy by size, not weight.
Do head new sections with the uppercase Avenir-700 kicker — green on light, gold on dark.
Do separate resting surfaces with the 1px green Hairline; reserve heavy shadows for menus, dropdowns and dialogs.
Do give buttons real vertical padding (14–16px) and let primary CTAs over imagery carry the soft lift shadow and a translateY(-2px) hover.
Do use Brick Red (#C0392B / tint #FDF1F0) for form validation — never stock Bootstrap red.
Do keep corners in the 3 → 6 → 8px range; only round icon buttons and avatars are circular.
Do keep every target ≥44px and every screen usable at 360px — on-site phone use is first-class.
donts: Don't introduce a third saturated colour, a gradient wash on a content surface, or gold as decoration.
Don't use cool blue-grey neutrals (#f1f5f9 family) or pure white page backgrounds.
Don't set headings bold (700+), in a second family, or with letter-spacing — tracking belongs only to the uppercase labels.
Don't put a glow/box-shadow on a focused input; the border-shift + faint green wash is the focus treatment.
Don't let the underlying Porto/Okler theme show through — no section-*-scale-* bands, revolution-slider chrome, template card shadows, or its cool greys.
Don't give the desktop nav a fifth link; overflow goes into the menu overlay.
Don't animate section entrances outside the .reveal system, and always leave the prefers-reduced-motion path intact.
